body.message:
As per your request, please find the 2-month rates for Cloud Tower

September: AED 4,500
October: AED 5,500

Please note that a security deposit of AED 2,000 is required. The booking will be on a monthly basis only (30 nights each month).

To confirm the rate and secure the unit for two months, an advance payment for the final month will also be required. This will allow us to block and reserve the unit for the full two-month period.

Thank you.
